title: rubus × ribifolius var. ohsimensis
intro: Rubus × ribifolius var. ohsimensis, commonly known as the Japanese bramble or Oshima black raspberry, is a type of hybrid raspberry species. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Rubus × ribifolius var. ohsimensis include its ability to relax and soothe the mind and body, while also reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ellagic acid, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
